event: A mechanistic analysis comparing GPT-2 with six-layer DistilGPT-2 reported a split under distillation: the Indirect Object Identification circuit was mechanistically lost, while the Greater-Than comparison mechanism persisted after being remapped from GPT-2 layer 9 to DistilGPT-2 layer 4. (OpenAI and Hugging Face, 2026-10-27.)
